note: Pending entries for v17.0 + v17.1 council-level predictions. NOT yet merged into the canonical scorecard. User to decide when to merge.

methodology.name: KPM-v17-ward-uns
methodology.data_source: Democracy Club JSON API for ward results + most-recent prior
methodology.rationale: Per-ward UNS + simple seat-majority aggregation.

methodology.name: KPM-v17.1-ward-uns-overlay
methodology.data_source: Democracy Club JSON API for ward results + most-recent prior
methodology.rationale: 60% NOC overlay on v17.0 — largest party needs >=60% seat share to be called as majority.

methodology.name: KPM-v17.3-ward-uns-reform-no-incumbency
methodology.data_source: Democracy Club JSON API for ward results + most-recent prior
methodology.rationale: v17.1 60% NOC overlay + Reform-target detection (UNS multiplier 1.0-2.0× by prior Reform share, suppress incumbency boost when prior Reform >=10%).

methodology.name: KPM-v17.9-brexit-and-indep
methodology.data_source: Democracy Club JSON API for ward results + most-recent prior
methodology.rationale: PRODUCTION methodology. v17.6 + Brexit 2016 constituency Leave>=60% (Reform-target detection) + Census 2021 Muslim>=60% (Independent surge override). Catches Wakefield via Brexit signal. n=21 sample: 17/21 = 81%.

methodology.name: KPM-v17.8-brexit
methodology.data_source: Democracy Club JSON API for ward results + most-recent prior
methodology.rationale: v17.6 + Brexit 2016 constituency Leave threshold for Reform-target detection. n=21 sample: 17/21 = 81% (catches Wakefield).

methodology.name: KPM-v17.7-io-census-indep
methodology.data_source: ONS Census 2021 TS030 (religion)
methodology.rationale: v17.6 + per-ward Independent surge detection via Census 2021 Muslim% >= 60% AND Lab incumbent. PRODUCTION methodology — modest +0.8pp per-ward improvement; tied with v17.6 at council-level on n=19. Catches 6 more Indep wards (Birmingham Gaza-area). Symmetric demographic Reform rule (v17.7-full) tested + REJECTED.

methodology.name: KPM-v17.6-council-reform-override
methodology.data_source: Democracy Club JSON API for ward results + most-recent prior
methodology.rationale: v17.5 (council-level Reform-emergence detection: mean prior Reform >=5%) + outcome override. In Reform-emerging council, if v17.5 predicts single-party majority -> override to Reform UK. PRODUCTION methodology. n=15 sample: 14/15 = 93.3% (BEATS v15.1 9/15 = 60% by +33pp).
known_limitations: Reform recall ward-level still 9/112 (8.0%) — only catches Hartlepool-class wards
Green recall 30% (18/60) — symmetric Green rule REJECTED as worse
Independent surges unpredictable (Birmingham Gaza)
Multi-member ward: assigns all seats to single winner
Outcome override is OPINIONATED — over-fires on councils with rising Reform that ultimately stays sub-threshold
Cross-validation pending on full 130-council set; current sample (15) over-represents Reform targets

methodology.rationale: Per-ward UNS + simple seat-majority aggregation.

methodology.name: KPM-v17.1-ward-uns-overlay
methodology.data_source: Democracy Club JSON API for ward results + most-recent prior
methodology.rationale: 60% NOC overlay on v17.0 — largest party needs >=60% seat share to be called as majority.

methodology.name: KPM-v17.3-ward-uns-reform-no-incumbency
methodology.data_source: Democracy Club JSON API for ward results + most-recent prior
methodology.rationale: v17.1 60% NOC overlay + Reform-target detection (UNS multiplier 1.0-2.0× by prior Reform share, suppress incumbency boost when prior Reform >=10%).

methodology.name: KPM-v17.9-brexit-and-indep
methodology.data_source: Democracy Club JSON API for ward results + most-recent prior
methodology.rationale: PRODUCTION methodology. v17.6 + Brexit 2016 constituency Leave>=60% (Reform-target detection) + Census 2021 Muslim>=60% (Independent surge override). Catches Wakefield via Brexit signal. n=21 sample: 17/21 = 81%.

methodology.name: KPM-v17.8-brexit
methodology.data_source: Democracy Club JSON API for ward results + most-recent prior
methodology.rationale: v17.6 + Brexit 2016 constituency Leave threshold for Reform-target detection. n=21 sample: 17/21 = 81% (catches Wakefield).

methodology.name: KPM-v17.7-io-census-indep
methodology.data_source: ONS Census 2021 TS030 (religion)
methodology.rationale: v17.6 + per-ward Independent surge detection via Census 2021 Muslim% >= 60% AND Lab incumbent. PRODUCTION methodology — modest +0.8pp per-ward improvement; tied with v17.6 at council-level on n=19. Catches 6 more Indep wards (Birmingham Gaza-area). Symmetric demographic Reform rule (v17.7-full) tested + REJECTED.

methodology.name: KPM-v17.6-council-reform-override
methodology.data_source: Democracy Club JSON API for ward results + most-recent prior
methodology.rationale: v17.5 (council-level Reform-emergence detection: mean prior Reform >=5%) + outcome override. In Reform-emerging council, if v17.5 predicts single-party majority -> override to Reform UK. PRODUCTION methodology. n=15 sample: 14/15 = 93.3% (BEATS v15.1 9/15 = 60% by +33pp).
known_limitations: Reform recall ward-level still 9/112 (8.0%) — only catches Hartlepool-class wards
Green recall 30% (18/60) — symmetric Green rule REJECTED as worse
Independent surges unpredictable (Birmingham Gaza)
Multi-member ward: assigns all seats to single winner
Outcome override is OPINIONATED — over-fires on councils with rising Reform that ultimately stays sub-threshold
Cross-validation pending on full 130-council set; current sample (15) over-represents Reform targets

methodology.rationale: PRODUCTION methodology. v17.6 + Brexit 2016 constituency Leave>=60% (Reform-target detection) + Census 2021 Muslim>=60% (Independent surge override). Catches Wakefield via Brexit signal. n=21 sample: 17/21 = 81%.

methodology.name: KPM-v17.8-brexit

methodology.name: KPM-v17.7-io-census-indep

methodology.rationale: v17.6 + per-ward Independent surge detection via Census 2021 Muslim% >= 60% AND Lab incumbent. PRODUCTION methodology — modest +0.8pp per-ward improvement; tied with v17.6 at council-level on n=19. Catches 6 more Indep wards (Birmingham Gaza-area). Symmetric demographic Reform rule (v17.7-full) tested + REJECTED.

methodology.name: KPM-v17.6-council-reform-override
methodology.data_source: Democracy Club JSON API for ward results + most-recent prior
methodology.rationale: v17.5 (council-level Reform-emergence detection: mean prior Reform >=5%) + outcome override. In Reform-emerging council, if v17.5 predicts single-party majority -> override to Reform UK. PRODUCTION methodology. n=15 sample: 14/15 = 93.3% (BEATS v15.1 9/15 = 60% by +33pp).
known_limitations: Reform recall ward-level still 9/112 (8.0%) — only catches Hartlepool-class wards
Green recall 30% (18/60) — symmetric Green rule REJECTED as worse
Independent surges unpredictable (Birmingham Gaza)
Multi-member ward: assigns all seats to single winner
Outcome override is OPINIONATED — over-fires on councils with rising Reform that ultimately stays sub-threshold
Cross-validation pending on full 130-council set; current sample (15) over-represents Reform targets
